theme.layout.compact_hint: Flat cards close together — more posts on screen.

report.title: Report content
report.intro.space: This report goes to the space's moderators — its owner, admins and moderators. Household admins don't see it.
report.intro.household: Reports go to your household admin. If the content lives on a Global Federation Server, the report also forwards there for community review unless you opt out below.
report.household_only: Don't share this report beyond my household
report.household_only_hint: Keep the moderation loop local even when the content came from a Global Federation Server.
report.sent.space: Report sent to this space's moderators.
report.sent.household: Report sent to your household admin.
report.sent.household_gfs: Report sent to your household admin and any connected Global Server.
report.member_title: Report this member to the space's moderators
reports.heading: Reports
reports.hint: What members flagged in this space. Act on the content (show it, remove a post), then Resolve — or Dismiss an unfounded report.
reports.target_gone: This content has since been removed.
reports.member_gone: This person is no longer a member.
reports.remove_post_confirm: Remove this post for everyone in the space and mark the report resolved?
reports.about_you: This report is about you. Nobody else in the space can review it, so you can dismiss it — who filed it stays hidden.
space.proposal.owner_body: A proposal to {action} needs the space owner to approve.
space.proposal.admin_body: A proposal to {action} needs a majority of admins to approve.
space.proposal.waiting_owner: Waiting for the space owner to decide.
space.proposal.waiting_admins: Waiting for the space admins to decide.
space.proposal.fwd.invite: invite a member to this space
stickies.report_title: Report this note to the space's moderators
stickies.read_only_archived: This space is archived — its sticky notes are read-only.
stickies.read_only_viewer: You can read these notes but not add or change them.
space.followers.intro: When off — the default — this space is listed in the directory, but nothing posted here is published and nobody outside can follow it. Turning it on lets anyone follow along read-only — separate from who may join and post.
space.followers.allow: Let anyone follow this space (makes its posts public)
space.followers.members_only_note: Posting (text, images, polls, etc.) always stays member-only.
space.followers.off_note: Turn on following above to let followers react or comment.
space.gfs_publish.intro: Your GFS (Global Federation Server) is the server that connects households. Choose how members' posts, comments and reactions reach followers through it. Only you, the owner, can change this.
space.gfs_publish.private_intro: Choose how members post to each other through the GFS while you're offline. The GFS never learns the space's name or what is posted, only which households take part. Only you, the owner, can change this.
space.gfs_publish.trusted_help: The default. Members can post even while you're offline. The GFS sees which household posted, never what they posted.
space.gfs_publish.strict_help: Members post anonymously: the GFS can't see which household posted. Households that don't support this yet post through this household instead, so their posts wait until you're back online.
space.gfs_publish.strict_switch_note: Members don't need to do anything after you save.
space.private_gfs.intro: The GFS (Global Federation Server) connects households that aren't paired with each other.
space.private_gfs.toggle: Use the GFS for this space
space.private_gfs.on_help: Anyone with a GFS link can join, even households you're not connected to, and members get each other's posts while you're offline. The GFS sees which households take part, never the space's name or posts.
space.private_gfs.off_help: Only households you're already connected to can join, with a local link. Nothing from this space goes to the GFS.
space.private_gfs.owner_only: Only you, the owner, can change this.
space.private_gfs.off_note: Saving turns off this space's GFS links. Members don't need to do anything.
space.private_gfs.link_members_body: They joined with a GFS link and can only reach this space through the GFS. Remove them from the space first, then turn the GFS off.
space.private_gfs.link_members_toast: Not saved: some households joined with a GFS link.
invite.via.gfs_hint: Anyone can join through the GFS (Global Federation Server), no pairing needed
invite.via.internal_hint: Only households you're already connected to
invite.via.gfs_off_owner: This space doesn't use the GFS. Turn it on in the space settings to make GFS links.
invite.via.gfs_off: This space doesn't use the GFS. Only its owner can turn it on.
invite.via.created_internal: Local link: only households already connected to yours can use it.
invite.via.badge_legacy_hint: Made before this space had the GFS setting. It still works. The first person to join with it turns the GFS on for this space.
onboarding.gfs.title: Connect to the GFS
onboarding.gfs.intro: The GFS (Global Federation Server) is a server that connects households with each other. You can use it, but you don't have to.
onboarding.gfs.sees_body: Which households take part. Never what you post.
onboarding.gfs.default_note: Nothing is sent unless you tick this. You can skip it and connect later in Settings → Connections.
onboarding.gfs.success: You're connected to the GFS. You can manage it in Settings → Connections.
onboarding.gfs.pending: Waiting for the GFS to approve your household. You can check on it in Settings → Connections.
onboarding.gfs.error_unreachable: Couldn't reach the GFS. Try again, or connect later in Settings → Connections.
onboarding.gfs.error_closed: This GFS isn't taking sign-ups right now. You can connect later with a pairing code in Settings → Connections.
onboarding.gfs.error_busy: The GFS is busy. Try again in a minute.
onboarding.gfs.error_refused: The GFS didn't accept this household. You can try again later in Settings → Connections.
onboarding.gfs.no_external_url: To connect, Social Home needs its External URL: the address other households reach it at. Set it in Settings → Connections, then connect there.
onboarding.gfs.no_external_url_ha: To connect, Social Home needs a public address from Home Assistant. Turn on remote access in Home Assistant, then connect in Settings → Connections.
onboarding.gfs.illus_meta: Sees who takes part, never what's posted
onboarding.gfs.error_identity: This doesn't look like the Social Home GFS. Check the address in settings.
invite.title: Invite to space
invite.intro: Make a link or code to share. Whoever gets it joins from their own Social Home.
invite.uses.label: How many people can use this link?
invite.expiry.label: Stops working after
invite.expiry.never_hint: A link that never expires keeps working until its uses run out or you revoke it. Anyone it was forwarded to can still join.
invite.publish.note: Publishing gets you a plain web link you can send to someone who has never heard of Social Home. The GFS only ever shows the space name and the code.
invite.publish.blocked_default: This GFS can't host invite links yet.
invite.created.web_link_limit: The web link is the exception: it stops opening after {days} days, because the GFS only keeps it that long. The code below keeps working until its uses run out or you revoke it.
invite.code.label: Invite code · paste into chat
invite.web_link.label: Web link · published
invite.web_link.hint: Anyone with this link sees the space name and can ask for the code. They join from their own Social Home.
invite.qr.label: QR code · scan with another device
invite.copy_failed_code: Couldn't copy. Select the code and copy it yourself.
invite.copy_failed_link: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.
invite.revoke_confirm.title: Revoke this invite link?
invite.revoke_confirm.body: This link stops working right away, here and on the GFS. People who already joined with it stay.
invite.links.title: Active links
invite.links.error: Couldn't load the links for this space.
space.settings.title: Space settings
space.settings.name: Name
space.join.request_sub: People ask to join, and an admin says yes.
space.visibility.private_sub: Hidden. Only people you invite can see it.
space.visibility.household_sub: Everyone in your home is a member automatically.
space.visibility.public_sub: Listed on the public map for anyone to find.
space.retention.label: Delete posts older than
space.retention.days_hint: days (leave empty or 0 to keep posts forever)
space.retention.applies: This applies to posts and comments in the feed. Calendar entries and pages are never deleted.
space.features.hint: Hide tabs you don't use in this space. Pages, events, tasks, sticky notes and albums are kept and come back when you turn the tab on again.
space.post_types.hint: Choose which kinds of posts members can make in this feed. Turning one off hides it from the composer. Existing posts of that kind stay visible.
space.post_types.none_on: Turn on at least one kind of post.
space.location.toggle: Show a map tab to members of this space
space.location.gps_hint: Members who turn it on share their GPS position with the space. Positions are rounded to about 10 m before they leave your home server.
space.location.zone_hint: Your home server matches each member's position to a zone of this space and sends only the zone name. Exact positions never leave your household. Members outside every zone show nothing.
space.location.ha_zones_note: Zone names from Home Assistant are never sent to a space. Only this space's own zones are shared.
space.location.zone_on_toast: Zone only is on. Members will see only zone names within seconds.
space.location.gps_on_toast: Live GPS is on. Members will see GPS pins within seconds.
space.here.toggle: Let owners and admins notify everyone with @here
space.here.hint: Notifies every member who hasn't muted this space, at most once every 10 minutes per person. When members use @here, no one is notified.
space.admin_authority.intro: Off by default. Turn it on only if you want your admins to keep the space running without you.
space.admin_authority.hint: Space admins can moderate, invite and publish while you're offline.
space.tier.heading: Who can find this space
space.tier.intro: With more than one admin, a change needs most admins to agree before it takes effect. No single admin can make the space public alone.
space.tier.label: Visibility
space.tier.public: Public — listed in this household's directory
space.tier.proposed: Change proposed. Most admins need to agree.
space.gfs.public_link_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Long-press the link to copy it yourself.
space.gfs.publish_confirm_body: Publishing lists this space on the GFS so anyone can find and view it. The GFS may hold it for review before it goes live. You can unpublish at any time.
space.archive.heading: Archive
space.archive.intro: Hide this space and make it read-only without deleting anything. You can undo this at any time.
space.archive.archived_body: This space is read-only and hidden from your active spaces. Everything is kept. Unarchive it to use it again.
space.archive.removed_lead: You were removed from this space.
space.archive.readonly_copy: It can't be brought back. This is a read-only copy of what you had.
space.dissolve.heading: Danger zone
space.dissolve.intro: Deletes the space and all its content for every member, for good. With more than one admin, this opens a proposal that most admins must approve. No single admin, not even the owner, can delete the space alone.
space.dissolve.confirm_body: This deletes the space and everything in it (posts, photos, events) for every member household. You can't undo this. With more than one admin, most admins need to agree first. To just hide it, archive it instead.
space.dissolve.proposed: Dissolving proposed. Most admins need to agree.
space.version_banner.title: Some members are on an older version
space.version_banner.body: These space features won't work for everyone until their household updates Social Home:
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to Social Home
onboarding.welcome.body: Your private household: a feed, calendar, tasks, shopping, photos and calls. It all runs on your own server and works with Home Assistant.
onboarding.feed.title: A feed for the people you live with
onboarding.feed.body: Post photos, polls and updates that stay inside your household. No ads, no algorithm. Just the people you live with.
onboarding.feed.illus_text: Pasta night again? New recipe from grandma.
onboarding.lists.title: Shared lists, calendar and chores
onboarding.lists.body: The shopping list by the door, the calendar on the fridge, tasks split between everyone. Always up to date on every phone or tablet you've signed in on.
onboarding.connect.title: Connect with other households, privately
onboarding.connect.body: Connect with another household by scanning a QR code. Messages, photos and events are encrypted on the way, and your data stays on your server.
space.settings_page.title: {name} — settings
space.settings_page.members_only_body: Only members of this space can open its settings.
space.settings_page.member_note: These are your own automations for this space. Your notification level is on the 🔔 bell in the space header. Owners and admins manage the rest.
space.create.title: Create a space
space.create.name: Name *
space.create.global_needs_gfs_admin: Connect a GFS to publish worldwide.
space.create.gfs_hint_member: Want a Global space? Ask a household admin to connect a GFS (Global Federation Server) first.
space.create.map_intro: Public spaces can be pinned on the map so people nearby can find them. The location is rounded to about 11 m.
space.create.location_optional: Optional. Add a location so people nearby can find you on the map.
space.create.location_unavailable: This browser can't share your location.
space.create.location_failed: Couldn't get your location. Enter it by hand.
space.members.nickname_title: Set a nickname (only you see it)
remote_invite.title: Add someone to this space
remote_invite.empty: There's nobody else to add yet. Add household members in Settings, or pair with another household to invite their people too.
remote_invite.no_matches: No matches. Try a different name.
remote_invite.pick_first: Pick someone from the list first.
remote_invite.send_failed: Couldn't send the invite. Try again.
space.about.cover_hint: Shown as a banner at the top of the space. Up to 10 MB. Large photos are made smaller for you.
space.about.icon_hint: The space's picture. It shows as a circle on the banner and in the tab bar. Without one, the emoji is used.
space.about.text_hint: Shown at the top of the space. You can use bold, italic, lists, links and code (Markdown).
space.links.title: Quick links
space.links.intro: Shortcuts every member sees under the space header. Handy for a family wiki, a shared shopping board or a calendar link.
space.links.empty: No links yet. Add one below.
space.links.required: Enter a name and an address.
space.age.intro: Children with child protection turned on can't join this space if they are younger than the minimum age. The category only groups the space with similar ones when people look for spaces. It doesn't keep anyone out.
emoji_field.label: Icon
emoji_field.hint_pick: Pick an emoji for this space
emoji_field.hint_change: Tap the icon to change it
space.bots.intro: Let Home Assistant automations post in this space. Each bot has its own name, icon and secret token. Its posts show the bot's picture instead of a plain "Home Assistant" label.
space.bots.allow: Allow bots to post in this space
space.bots.disabled_banner: An admin turned off bots for this space. Existing bots stay, but they can't post until bots are turned back on.
space.bots.shared_desc: Added by admins. Posts show "via Home Assistant", not a member's name.
space.bots.shared_empty_admin: No shared bots yet. Add one below, for example for the doorbell, the laundry or parcels.
space.bots.personal_desc: Any member can add their own. Posts show who added the bot, so they can't pass for household alerts.
space.bots.turn_on_first: Turn on "Allow bots to post in this space" above to add bots.
space.bots.rotate_confirm: Make a new token for "{name}"? The old token stops working right away. Home Assistant automations that use it stop until you paste in the new token.
space.bots.delete_confirm: Delete the bot "{name}"? Its posts stay (shown as from Home Assistant), but its token stops working. This can't be undone.
space.bots.type_shared_hint: Posts don't show a member's name.
space.bots.type_personal_hint: Posts show your name, so others know it's yours.
space.bots.name: Name
space.bots.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Used in the Home Assistant service name
space.bots.reveal_once: This token is shown only once.
space.bots.reveal_body: Copy it now and paste it into your Home Assistant configuration. If you lose it, make a new token on this page.
space.bots.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the token and copy it yourself.
connections.transport.internet_title: Over the internet. Works, but slower than direct.
connections.detail.alias_hint: Only your household sees this name.
connections.detail.alias_saved: Renamed to "{name}". Only your household sees this name.
connections.detail.alias_cleared: Nickname removed. Showing the household's own name.
connections.detail.gfs_only_hint: The GFS took these messages, but they aren't confirmed as delivered yet. It keeps them for up to 24 hours until this household connects.
connections.detail.queued_hint: They'll be sent automatically once this household is reachable again.
connections.detail.dropped: {n} messages could not be delivered and were dropped.
connections.detail.dropped_one: {n} message could not be delivered and was dropped.
connections.detail.direct_hint: A fast direct connection between your household and theirs.
connections.detail.internet_hint: A direct connection isn't possible, usually because of a router or firewall. Everything still works, just a bit slower.
connections.detail.gfs_hint: This household joined with an invite link, so everything reaches it through the GFS (Global Federation Server).
connections.detail.recheck_sent: Asked {name} to send its app version again
connections.detail.recheck_failed: Couldn't check the version. Try again.
connections.detail.visible_hint: Untick someone to hide them from this household. Their chats, highlights and moments there are deleted, and new ones won't arrive. Posts in shared spaces stay. Tick again to show them for new content.
connections.detail.visibility_failed: Couldn't change who they can see. Try again.
connections.detail.remove_message: This disconnects this household for good. Shared spaces stop syncing. To reconnect, you'll need to pair again with a QR code.
connections.requests.title: Pair requests
connections.requests.intro: A household you're connected to introduced a new household. Approve to connect right away. Their introduction replaces the QR scan.
connections.admin_only: Only household admins can manage connections. Ask an admin to pair with another household or change a connection.
connections.pending: {n} pairings waiting for the other household.
connections.pending_one: {n} pairing waiting for the other household.
connections.space_only_note: Shared space only. No messages, profiles or presence.
connections.unpair_confirm: Unpair this household? You'll lose access to its spaces.
connections.ext.title: External address
connections.ext.intro: The address other households use to reach this Social Home. Pairing needs it. Without one, creating a pairing code fails.
connections.ext.label: Address
connections.ext.effective: Other households currently reach you at {url}
connections.ext.not_configured: Not set up yet. Pairing won't work until you add one.
connections.ext.clear_hint: Clear the field and save to go back to this setup's own configuration.
connections.ext.saved_notified: External address saved. {n} paired households were told.
connections.ext.saved_notified_one: External address saved. {n} paired household was told.
connections.ext.invalid: Enter a full web address, e.g. https://home.example.com
connections.diag.note: Connection state, when households were last reachable, and messages waiting to be sent. No messages, names, keys or locations. Safe to attach to a bug report.
connections.ice.title: Connection servers
connections.ice.none: No connection servers set up. Households behind most home routers won't be able to reach each other directly.
connections.ice.hint_no_turn: Only address lookup (STUN) is set up. That's enough for most home networks, but not for stricter ones. Add a backup route (TURN) if pairing connects but stays slow.
connections.ice.hint_turn_broken: A backup route is listed, but it has no password, so it will be refused. Connections then quietly take the slow path. Check its secret.
connections.ice.hint_ready: A backup route is available, so households behind strict routers can still reach each other.
connections.ice.from_ha: This list comes from Home Assistant and refreshes daily.
connections.map.no_coords: Paired, but no home location yet.
space.archived.dissolved_title: This space was dissolved by its owner.
space.archived.dissolved_body: You can still read what was shared, but nobody can post or comment. It can't be brought back.
space.archived.dissolved_empty: This space was dissolved by its owner. You can still read what was shared.
space.archived.removed_title: You're no longer a member of this space.
space.archived.removed_body: You can still read what you had, but you can't post or comment.
space.archived.removed_empty: You're no longer a member of this space. You can still read what you had.
space.archived.title: This space is archived.
space.archived.body: Everything is kept, but nobody can post or comment until an admin unarchives it.
space.archived.empty: This space is archived. Unarchive it in the settings to post again.
space.feed.empty_body: Be the first to share something. Members from other households see what you post here.
space.feed.empty_hint: Write your first post in the box above.
space.subscriber.title: You're following this space.
space.subscriber.react_comment: You can react and comment. Only full members can post. Ask an admin if you want to post too.
space.subscriber.react: You can react to posts. Only full members can comment and post. Ask an admin if you want to join in.
space.subscriber.comment: You can comment. Only full members can react and post. Ask an admin if you want to react too.
space.subscriber.read_only: You see new posts here, but you can't post, comment or react. Ask an admin to make you a full member if you want to join in.
space.subscriber.unsubscribe_title: Stop getting updates from this space.
space.subscriber.unsubscribed: You no longer follow this space
